rule: This file is written BEFORE the measuring run. Every figure in it is a PREDICTION. A miss is recorded, never edited.
the_fix: `eachEvent('Update')` (data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:538, mainline sim/battle-actions.ts:967) now runs in the STATUS road's pay-your-own-HP-and-leave branch, between the cost and the switch. The authority raises it for every move that CONNECTS — a status move's `spreadMoveHit` returns `true`, which becomes `damage[i] = 0`, so the loop does not break above the pass — and the selfSwitch is queued later still, in `useMove`, after `useMoveInner` returns. medicham2's `_stepUpdate` lives in the DAMAGING step list and its own header records that status moves never reach it.
why_it_is_board_material: Harmless for every status move that STAYS: the between-action pass settles the same thing a moment later, at the same point in the stream. Not harmless for one that LEAVES — by the time that pass runs the body is on the bench and out of `actA`/`actB`, so it keeps an unspent pinch berry AND the HP it should have healed, on a body that comes back later.

the_one_game_named_before_the_run.what: Orthworm Shed Tails from full: the sub goes up, ceil(145/2)=73 is paid leaving 72/145, the authority eats the Sitrus to 108 and only then leaves. medicham2 left on 72 holding it.

predicted_after.counters: MEDSEEN.selfSwitchUpdateRan non-zero on any corpus containing a Shed Tail; selfSwitchUpdateSettled non-zero on one where the user held something the pass can settle
predicted_after.probes: tests/probe_selfswitch_update_pass.js GREEN with its knob moving the bench HP and its silent control unmoved; the two earlier probes still GREEN

why_it_might_miss_HIGH: Shed Tail carries 177 sheets, so the pool may hold games where the pass now settles something on a body OTHER than the pivoting one — the event is field-wide. Anything it settles a moment early there was going to be settled at the top of the next action anyway, so no board should move, but a berry eaten one action earlier changes what a later handler reads and can surface a divergence the old ordering was standing in front of. That is exactly the shape of batch D's single miss.
why_it_might_miss_LOW: The named game may carry a second defect behind this one, in which case board-material lands at 43.
not_claimed: the OTHER pivot family (`pivotStatus` — Parting Shot, Chilly Reception) does NOT get the pass: its members change no HP and no status on the body that leaves, so there is nothing for the pass to settle, and widening it without a failing probe would be adding a call on an argument rather than on a measurement
no strength gain is claimed and none can be measured from here
the pinned pool should move by 1; the roster and census should not move at all
